---
title: v3.0.2 — Manual Branch Validation
---

## Overview

Introduce a manually triggered GitHub Actions workflow for validating development branches before opening a pull request, without requiring a Release version bump or Release Metadata changes on the branch being tested.

## Highlights

- Run the complete Rust and package validation suites on macOS and Windows in parallel after the shared preflight checks pass.
- Reuse the existing package integrity checks, installed CLI smoke evidence, and Rust workspace validation report. Require every validation stage and the report to succeed.
- Cancel superseded Branch Validation runs for the same ref and superseded runs within each PR validation workflow for the same PR. Keep Branch, PR validation, credentials validation, and release concurrency groups independent; do not cancel an in-progress release.
- Share workflow YAML checks, approved Actions checks, and release-script tests between Branch and PR Validation; preserve the existing PR-specific release checks, job ordering, and publication workflow.
- Add regression tests covering manual-only triggering, concurrency, job dependencies, shared preflight, and rejection of incomplete validation results.
